# BookBreaker

> Bookbreaker is an arbitrage and +EV engine that reports how wrong it might be: the devig spread, the chance of getting on, and what your record can support. It is free, with no account, and it never sends your record anywhere — the ledger is a SQLite file on your own disk. Run it as the Mac app, or run the same engine from the command line.

Bookbreaker is a free analysis tool: a calculator for prices, not a sportsbook and not advice. It does not place bets, hold money, connect to sportsbook accounts or know whether a book will honour a price. Bookbreaker never asks for a sportsbook login. Your history comes in by importing the CSV your book lets you download, or by pasting a betslip. The command-line live board, if you run it, requests public Kalshi and Polymarket prices and sends nothing about you.

**What the numbers here do not promise.** Bookbreaker reports what a price implies and how uncertain that is. It cannot tell you that you will win. A locked figure holds only if both bets are accepted and stand, and a book can void, limit or refuse a bet. Bet only what you can afford to lose.

**Who it is for.** Adults 21 and over, in a state where sports betting is legal. Whether a bet is legal where you are is yours to check; the app cannot know.

**Responsible gambling.** 21+ and present in a state where betting is legal. Gambling carries a risk of financial loss, and nothing here predicts that you will win. If it stops being fun, it is not fun — call or text [1-800-MY-RESET](tel:+18006973738), the national helpline, or call [1-800-GAMBLER](tel:+18004262537), or visit [ncpgambling.org](https://www.ncpgambling.org/help-treatment/). More on [responsible gambling](https://bookbreaker.bet/responsible-gambling/).

**Not affiliated with any sportsbook.** Bookbreaker is independent. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or paid by any sportsbook, exchange or prediction market. No link on this site is an affiliate link.

## Download

- [Download Bookbreaker](https://bookbreaker.bet/download/): Version 0.1.6. Free, no account. Checksums are published for every release.
- [The Mac app, Bookbreaker-0.1.6.dmg](https://bookbreaker.bet/releases/Bookbreaker-0.1.6.dmg): 8.2 MB. Signed with a Developer ID and notarised by Apple. It needs a Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later).
- [The command line, overlay-0.1.6-py3-none-any.whl](https://bookbreaker.bet/releases/overlay-0.1.6-py3-none-any.whl): 199 KB. The same engine, as a command-line tool for macOS, Linux or Windows. It is pure Python with no third-party dependencies and needs Python 3.9 or newer. Install it with `pip install https://bookbreaker.bet/releases/overlay-0.1.6-py3-none-any.whl`, then run `overlay --help`.
- [Licence](https://bookbreaker.bet/releases/LICENSE.txt): Free to download and run on as many machines as you control. You may not pass it on, sell it, bundle it, or run it as a service for other people. It is provided as is, without warranty of any kind.

## Key pages

- [How Bookbreaker finds arbs and prices every bet](https://bookbreaker.bet/how-it-works/): Welcome offers after every cost, middles counted rather than assumed, which books you can legally use, and what the tool will not do.
- [Betting calculators — worked, not blank](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/): No-vig odds, expected value, arbitrage staking, Kelly, hold, bonus conversion, middles and closing line value — each worked through on real prices.
- [Betting guides — the parts other guides skip](https://bookbreaker.bet/guides/): Devigging, closing line value, bonus conversion, arbitrage, middles, limits and bankroll — each answered with the arithmetic done.
- [Sports betting by state — which books limit winners](https://bookbreaker.bet/sportsbooks/): Every US state, the licensed sportsbooks covering it, and which of them limit accounts that win. Dated, and computed rather than supplied by a sportsbook.
- [Sportsbook sign-up bonuses ranked by what you actually keep](https://bookbreaker.bet/offers/): Every welcome offer priced after hedging: what each bonus converts to in cash locked if both bets stand, the steps to collect it, and where each was read.
- [Bookbreaker vs OddsJam, AVO, Pikkit and every arb tool](https://bookbreaker.bet/vs/): OddsJam, AVO, Betstamp, Pikkit and the rest compared on price, features and limits — every claim dated and linked to its source.
- [Account longevity — why limits matter more than edge](https://bookbreaker.bet/account-longevity/)
- [What your betting record actually proves](https://bookbreaker.bet/what-your-record-proves/): A 2% edge swings between -7% and +11% over a season. Why most betting records prove nothing, why slicing makes it worse, and what converges faster than profit.

## Privacy, terms and responsible gambling

- [Privacy — what Bookbreaker collects](https://bookbreaker.bet/privacy/): This site runs no analytics, no pixels and no cookies, and the app sends nothing about you anywhere. What GitHub Pages logs, and what the app can reach.
- [Terms of use — Bookbreaker](https://bookbreaker.bet/terms/): Bookbreaker is a free analysis tool, not a sportsbook and not advice. Not affiliated with any sportsbook. 21+ where sports betting is legal.
- [Responsible gambling — Bookbreaker](https://bookbreaker.bet/responsible-gambling/): Bookbreaker is for adults 21+ where betting is legal. Help any time: 1-800-MY-RESET or 1-800-GAMBLER, plus limits and self-exclusion.
